definitions.explanation: A loop of stretchy rubber used to hold things together. A common everyday office and household item.

examples.japanese: {輪|わ}ゴム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{束|たば}ねる→束ねる：13059_tabaneru⟧。
examples.english: To bundle with a rubber band.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{輪|わ}ゴム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{留|と}めて→留める：10053_tomeru⟧おいて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please secure the documents with a rubber band.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、{輪|わ}ゴム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}ばして→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I used to play by shooting rubber bands.

notes:
A basic everyday word. The standard term in Japanese for what English speakers call a rubber band or elastic band.

FORMS:
⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧ (ring, loop) + ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧ (rubber, from Dutch "gom")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {輪|わ}ゴム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{留|と}める→留める：10053_tomeru⟧: to fasten with a rubber band
- {輪|わ}ゴム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{束|たば}ねる→束ねる：13059_tabaneru⟧: to bundle with a rubber band
- {輪|わ}ゴム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}る→引っ張る：02402_hipparu⟧: to stretch a rubber band
- {輪|わ}ゴム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: a rubber band snaps

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ゴムバンド: rubber band — less common synonym
- ヘアゴム: hair tie, hair elastic — specifically for tying hair
- ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧⟦{紐|ひも}→紐：02251_himo⟧: elastic cord — longer and used in sewing or crafts
